text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services recommends stop control for the minor street at the uncontrolled intersection of Vista Humber Drive and The Elms in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on The Elms at Vista Humber Drive
